# `Q-12-12` — Categories Enabled But No Item Has Any

> A listing configures `categories:` but no resolved item has
> any categories defined; the sidebar is suppressed.

## What this means

A listing's `categories:` key asks Quarto to render a sidebar
that groups items by their `categories` front-matter field. If
the listing is configured for that sidebar but every resolved
item is missing `categories:`, there is nothing to group on,
and the sidebar would render empty. Quarto suppresses it
instead and emits this warning.

## Why this happens

Two common causes:

- **The category fields exist on the items but under a
  different key.** Quarto reads `categories:` (plural); a
  single `category:` does not contribute.
- **The listing is freshly authored** and none of its items
  carry categories yet.

## How to fix

Add `categories:` to the front matter of the items that should
appear in each group:

```yaml
---
title: "My post"
categories: [news, weekly]
---
```

If you do not want a categories sidebar at all, set
`categories: false` on the listing to silence this warning.
